description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class 'SlidingTabsBasicFragment' that demonstrates the use of a custom SlidingTabLayout combined with a ViewPager to provide a tabbed interface with continuous feedback during scrolling. It includes inner classes for the PagerAdapter implementation that supplies pages and titles for the tabs.

classes.name: SlidingTabsBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates the use of SlidingTabLayout with ViewPager to create a tabbed interface with continuous feedback during scrolling.

classes.name: SamplePagerAdapter
classes.description: An inner class extending PagerAdapter that supplies page views and titles for the ViewPager used in the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and initializes the ViewPager and SlidingTabLayout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager with an adapter and associates it with the SlidingTabLayout for tab display.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of pages in the ViewPager (10).

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks whether a view corresponds to a specific key object.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each page/tab based on position.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and adds a page view for the specified position.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes a page view at the specified position.
